decision: The transport API key that .env.harness carried from commit fa5b1eb8 (2026-08-04) until it was untracked on 2026-11-04 (83c210e9 / d113901d) was revoked at its provider by the operator on 2026-11-11. No replacement key is issued: that provider is no longer used, and the private-host runs authenticate through the hardened IAM runtime role. The F3 rotation item is CLOSED and is not to be raised again.

rules.rule: The revoked key is inert; its string remaining in public git history is accepted. History is not rewritten (it would invalidate every published branch and the msca-dn-freeze-2026-11-11 tag for no protection).
rules.basis: Operator revoked the key at the provider, 2026-11-11.

rules.rule: A history scan for provider-key patterns (2026-11-11) found this one key and no other credential. CloudTrail evidence files from June-July 2026 carry old-account access-key IDs (AKIA/ASIA) only, with no secret access key; IDs are not secrets.
rules.basis: git log --all -p pattern scan, values never printed.

rules.rule: Recurrence guard: tests/test_no_tracked_secrets.py fails the full suite when .env.harness (or any .env file) is tracked or when a tracked file contains a provider API-key pattern.
